doc: The game API every mod runtime (Lua, JavaScript, native DLL) sees. Domains whose provider is 'registry' live under the global 'uc' (uc.mem, uc.player(1), ...); domains whose provider is 'context' are per-mod globals (log, settings, ui, on).

domains.name: log
domains.doc: Writes to the port's log (mods.log next to the exe) and to stderr. Shown with the mod id.

members.name: write
members.doc: Writes one line to the log.

domains.name: settings
domains.doc: The mod's own settings, the ones declared in mod.json. Values are saved with the port's settings.

members.name: get
members.doc: Current value of a declared setting; null for an unknown key.

members.name: set

args.name: value
args.doc: New value; numbers are clamped to the declared range.

members.doc: Changes a declared setting and saves it. Returns false (and changes nothing) for an unknown key or a value of the wrong type.

domains.name: events
domains.doc: Events are delivered to handlers registered with on(). Handlers run on the game thread (or the menu thread for ui callbacks) under a time budget; an error or an overrun counts as a failure of the mod.

members.name: on

args.name: event
args.doc: One of the event names below.

members.doc: Registers a handler. Several handlers for one event run in registration order.

members.name: on_load
members.doc: The mod was started. Payload: {}.

members.name: on_unload
members.doc: The mod is being stopped (game exit or script reload). Payload: {}.

members.name: on_step
members.doc: Once per nominal game frame (the game's own 30 Hz step: about 30 per second of game time, whatever the real step rate): a step shorter than a nominal frame skips it, a longer one runs it up to 4 times. Not delivered while the game is paused. Payload: {}.

members.name: on_settings_changed
members.doc: A setting of this mod changed in the menu. Payload: { key: string }.

members.name: on_weapon_fired
members.doc: A player fired. Payload: { slot: int }.

example.lua: on('on_weapon_fired', function(e) log.write('shot by ' .. e.slot) end)

members.name: on_damage_taken
members.doc: A player's damage meter rose. Payload: { slot: int, amount: float }.

members.name: on_reload
members.doc: A player started reloading. Payload: { slot: int }.

domains.name: ui
domains.doc: Free drawing in the mod's settings window (the gear button of the mod in the Mods tab of the Insert menu). Call these from the function registered with ui_draw(); they work only there. Widgets are identified by their label within the mod.

members.name: text
members.doc: Plain text.

members.name: button
members.doc: A button; true on the frame it is clicked.

members.name: checkbox
members.doc: A checkbox; returns the new state.

members.name: slider_int
members.doc: An integer slider; returns the new value.

members.name: slider_float
members.doc: A float slider; returns the new value.

members.name: combo
members.doc: A drop-down list; returns the selected index.

members.name: input_text
members.doc: A one-line text box; returns the text (at most 1024 bytes).

members.name: separator
members.doc: A horizontal line.

members.name: same_line
members.doc: Puts the next widget on the same line.

members.name: collapsing_header
members.doc: A foldable header; true while open (draw its content only then).

members.name: tooltip
members.doc: Shows a tooltip while the previous widget is hovered.

members.name: color_edit
members.doc: A colour picker; returns the new four numbers.

members.name: draw

args.name: callback
args.doc: Called every menu frame while the mod's settings window is open.

members.doc: Registers the function that draws the mod's settings window below the declared settings (Lua and JavaScript; a DLL draws through ImGui directly).

domains.name: hook
domains.doc: Callbacks on selected game functions. Only the functions listed under 'Hookable functions' accept hooks (the list grows with releases); each hook point costs nothing while no mod uses it.

members.name: list
members.doc: Names of the hookable functions.

example.lua: for _, name in ipairs(hook.list()) do log.write(name) end

members.name: pre

args.name: callback
args.doc: Called before the function runs with a table of its registers: r3..r10 as integers, f1..f8 as floats.

members.doc: Runs a callback before the game function. The callback may change the registers it is given (they are written back).

members.name: post
members.doc: Runs a callback after the game function returned (needs translator support; see hooks.md).

members.name: replace
members.doc: Replaces the game function (needs translator support; see hooks.md).

domains.name: mem
domains.doc: Guest (Wii) memory. Addresses are Wii virtual addresses: MEM1 0x80000000..0x817FFFFF, MEM2 0x90000000..0x93FFFFFF. Values are big-endian in the game; these functions convert. An address outside both ranges is an error (the script gets an exception), never a crash.

members.name: read_u8
members.doc: Reads an unsigned 8-bit value.

members.name: read_u16
members.doc: Reads an unsigned 16-bit value.

members.name: read_u32
members.doc: Reads an unsigned 32-bit value.

members.name: read_s8
members.doc: Reads a signed 8-bit value.

members.name: read_s16
members.doc: Reads a signed 16-bit value.

members.name: read_s32
members.doc: Reads a signed 32-bit value.

members.name: read_f32
members.doc: Reads a 32-bit float.

members.name: read_f64
members.doc: Reads a 64-bit float.

members.name: read_bytes
members.doc: Reads raw bytes.

members.name: write_u8
members.doc: Writes an unsigned 8-bit value.

members.name: write_u16
members.doc: Writes an unsigned 16-bit value.

members.name: write_u32
members.doc: Writes an unsigned 32-bit value.

members.name: write_s8
members.doc: Writes a signed 8-bit value.

members.name: write_s16
members.doc: Writes a signed 16-bit value.

members.name: write_s32
members.doc: Writes a signed 32-bit value.

members.name: write_f32
members.doc: Writes a 32-bit float.

members.name: write_f64
members.doc: Writes a 64-bit float.

members.name: write_bytes
members.doc: Writes raw bytes.

domains.name: symbols
domains.doc: Names the project knows for guest addresses (project/symbols.txt and the verified GX names). Most game functions have no name.

members.name: lookup
members.doc: Guest address of a named symbol, or null.

members.name: name_of
members.doc: Name of the symbol at exactly this address, or null.

domains.name: player
domains.doc: A player. uc.player(1) is player 1, uc.player(2) player 2 (co-op). Reading or writing a slot that is not in the game is an error; check 'present' first.

members.name: present
members.doc: True while the player exists in the current scene.

members.name: magazine
members.doc: Rounds left in the loaded magazine of the current weapon.

members.name: grenades
members.doc: Grenades in stock.

members.name: damage
members.doc: The damage meter: 0 is unhurt, 50 is dead. Writing 0 heals.

members.name: invulnerable
members.doc: While true the damage meter is reset to 0 every game step.

members.name: infinite_ammo
members.doc: While true the magazine is refilled to its starting size every game step.

members.name: position
members.doc: World position (x, y, z) in game units (10 cm).

domains.name: weapon
domains.doc: Parameters of a weapon type: one record of the game's weapon table, addressed by its id 0 to 19 (uc.weapon(0)). Id 0 is the handgun (15 rounds, damage 10), 1 a shotgun (6 rounds), 2 a submachine gun (50 rounds); the table has 20 records and the other ids are not named yet (read capacity and damage to tell them apart). A change applies to every weapon of that type from the weapon's next shot or reload on. The game fills the table at boot and at mission starts, so the API remembers what a mod set and writes it again at the next game step whenever the game's value differs; it lasts until the game exits.

members.name: damage
members.doc: Damage per hit (per pellet for a shotgun): the handgun's 10 takes a zombie down in two hits. Checked in the game: with 100 a hit takes 100 off a zombie (the body, head and limb multipliers stay).

members.name: fire_rate
members.doc: Shots per second, 0.05 to 60 (the handgun is 1; submachine guns 10 to 15). The game turns the rate into an interval (1 / rate) when a weapon is equipped; the API sets both the record and the interval of players holding the weapon, and keeps them. Checked in the game with automatic fire: a rate of 2 gives about twice the shots in the same time, 0.25 four times as many as 1. Semi-automatic weapons need `fire_mode = 'auto'` for the rate to matter while the trigger is held.

members.name: capacity
members.doc: Magazine size, 0 to 999. The game reads it when a reload ends: with 30 set for the handgun a reload refills 30 rounds.

members.name: reload_time
members.doc: Reload duration in seconds of game time (1.0 for the handgun, 2.3 for a shotgun); 0.2 makes a handgun reload about seven times faster.

members.name: fire_mode
members.doc: 'semi' (one shot per press), 'auto' (shots repeat while the button is held) or 'burst'. 'auto' on the handgun was checked in the game (a held trigger fires about every 22 frames instead of once); 'burst' is the value the game's record 3 uses and its effect on other weapons is untested. Reading a value the table holds that has no name gives 'mode <number>'.

members.name: view
members.doc: The world-to-view matrix as 12 floats (3 rows of 4).

members.name: list
members.doc: One object per enemy: { id: int, class: int, x: float, y: float, z: float, hp: float }. Only zombies are listed in this version.

example.lua: for _, e in ipairs(uc.enemies.list()) do log.write(e.hp) end

domains.name: input
domains.doc: Player input as the game sees it.

members.name: fire_held
members.doc: True while the fire button of the slot is held.

hookable.name: GameWeaponUpdate
hookable.doc: Per-step weapon update of a player; r3 is the weapon object (the player's weapon is player + 0x48), r4 the 'allowed' flag. Checked in the game: the hook is called with a guest address in r3, and clearing r4 stops the held trigger from firing.

hookable.name: PlayerEventHandler
hookable.doc: Player event handler (damage, firing and similar events).
